alerts.title: Trail Ridge Road Status Update
alerts.description: Trail Ridge Road will be closing at 5 p.m. on Friday, October 23, due to the forecast for snow, low visibility and freezing temperatures at higher elevations. The closure points will be at Many Parks Curve on the east side and Colorado River Trailhead on the west side. For the latest information on the status of Trail Ridge Road, call 970-586-1222.
